summary.zh: 实现向量库上的相似度检索与近邻查询

description.zh: 介绍语义检索与最近邻查询的常见写法，覆盖候选召回、结果排序以及性能取舍。适合为搜索功能或 RAG 检索层做选型与落地。需要已接入向量数据库。
description.en: Covers semantic search and nearest-neighbor queries, from candidate recall to ranking and performance tradeoffs. Suits building a search feature or the retrieval layer of RAG. Needs a vector database in place.
